name: Suzhou Good-Ark Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Suzhou Good-Ark Electronics Co., Ltd. engages in the design, manufacturing, packaging, and sale of semiconductor discrete device diode in China and internationally. It offers packaging technology of pinless integrated circuit products, discrete devices, automotive rectifier diodes, power modules, rectifier diode chips, silicon rectifier and switching diodes, voltage regulator diodes, miniature bridge stack, military fuses, and photovoltaic bypass modules for use in aerospace, automotive, green lighting, IT, household appliances, and power supply devices for large equipment.
